title: Casa Brisa | KEY.co
description_expanded: Located in The Preserve at Inlet Beach, this coastal gem provides access to a community pool, a pavilion with an outdoor fireplace, and a boardwalk to Lake Powell for paddleboarding and kayaking. Nature trails and easy access to dining and shopping add to the charm of this community. Inside, you'll find modern amenities including Smart TVs in the living areas and bedrooms, a second living area on the upstairs landing, and a cozy breakfast bar in the kitchen. The spacious paved patio and outdoor shower complete the experience, ensuring every moment of your stay is filled with luxury and relaxation. A spacious beach house in Inlet Beach, this luxurious four-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bathroom vacation home is the epitome of comfort and convenience. The home features inviting living areas, a screened porch, and ample space for everyone to relax. The gourmet kitchen, complete with quartz countertops and high-end appliances, is a culinary delight. With a grill in the backyard and the beach just a short ride away, this home is perfectly situated to enjoy everything 30A has to offer. Daily rounds of golf and complimentary bikes make exploring the stunning surroundings effortless and enjoyable.
